summary: Extends BEEP, a general framework for building application protocols, with an option that lets individual channels operate asynchronously. Normally a channel handles requests in a strict order; this experimental feature relaxes that for channels where it helps. It is an Experimental protocol, not a standards-track one.

eli5.summary: Think of a single checkout line where everyone must wait for the person ahead. This lets some lines move on without waiting, so quick jobs are not stuck behind slow ones.
